title: Wanpaku! Touken Ranbu TV Anime Debuts on January 6
content:
The official website for the anime of Sanrio 's Wanpaku! Touken Ranbu project announced on Monday the anime will debut on Tokyo MX on January 6, 2027, and will air on Wednesdays at 9:54 p.m. JST.

Gaku Kinoshita ( Yūsanchi! from Yū-hachi , Sumikko Gurashi: Koko ga Ochitsukun Desu ) is directing the anime at Fanworks , and Rieko Ebisu is writing the scripts. Midori Shimada is the art director.

The anime was first announced in January 2024.

The project has various goods, pop-up stores, and other collaborative items featuring the Touken Ranbu characters as redesigned by Sanrio .

The Touken Ranbu "sword personification training game" takes famous swords from Japanese history and interprets them as bishōnen . Nitroplus designed the characters and scenario. The game launched in Japan in January 2015.

The franchise has inspired the Katsugeki: Touken Ranbu television anime series and a planned upcoming anime film, as well as the Touken Ranbu: Hanamaru spinoff's two anime series, an anime film trilogy , and a compilation anime film. The franchise has also inspired two live-action films, a long-running stage musical series, a series of stage plays (separate from the stage musical versions), as well as various manga. The franchise had its first ever ice show in October.

Touken Ranbu Kai: Kyoden Moyuru Honnōji is the anime adaptation of the Touken Ranbu Kyoden Moyuru Honnōji stage play. The eight-episode anime premiered in April 2024. Touken Ranbu Kai -Dо̄den Chikashi Haberau Monora- , the prequel to the Touken Ranbu Kai: Kyoden Moyuru Honnōji anime, opened in a three-week limited engagement in Japan in August 2024.

Johren released the original Touken Ranbu browser game in English in April 2021, and released the smartphone version of the game in August 2021. Johren shut down the game's English and Chinese versions in August 2023.
author: ANN

title: 'Wanpaku! Touken Ranbu' Reveals Main Staff, Winter 2027 Premiere
content:
The official website of the Wanpaku! Touken Ranbu television anime revealed the main staff and a teaser visual (pictured). The anime series, based on the character project designed and produced by Sanrio for the Touken Ranbu Online game, will premiere on January 6 at 9:54 p.m. on Tokyo MX.

Staff Director: Gaku Kinoshita ( Sumikko Gurashi ) Script: Rieko Ebisu Art Director: Midori Shimada Studio: Fanworks

The original Touken Ranbu Online game has received adaptations in various media, including manga, television anime, and live-action films. The Touken Ranbu: Hanamaru manga, illustrated by Saru Hashino , was serialized on the Shounen Jump+ platform from December 2016 to April 2019. Shueisha published the fifth and final volume in June 2019.

• The Touken Ranbu: Hanamaru television anime, produced by Doga Kobo , aired for 12 episodes in Fall 2016. Its sequel, Zoku Touken Ranbu: Hanamaru ( Touken Ranbu: Hanamaru 2 ), followed with another 12-episodes in Winter 2018. The series was later concluded with the three-part theatrical project Toku: Touken Ranbu - Hanamaru - Setsugetsuka ( Touken Ranbu - Hanamaru Season 3 ), which screened in Japan on May 20, July 8, and September 1, 2022.

Other anime projects based on the game include Katsugeki/Touken Ranbu , produced by ufotable and first broadcast in Summer 2017. Touken Ranbu Kai: Kyoden Moyuru Honnouji , a new television anime based on the first stage play in the franchise, which aired in Spring 2024.

The Touken Ranbu live-action film premiered in Japanese theaters in January 2019. Its sequel, Touken Ranbu 2 , opened in Japanese theaters in March 2023.

The franchise has continued to expand into other forms of entertainment, with the official Touken Ranbu - ICE BLADE - ice show holding performances on October 3.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Black Witch Mirror Manga to End in 4th Volume
content:
Kadokawa is listing the fourth volume of Yonan Togawa 's Black Witch Mirror ( Kokufu Kyōdan ) manga as the final volume for the series. The volume will ship on January 15, 2027.

Titan Manga publishes the series in English and describes the story:

In a world where mirrors are more than simple reflections, they serve as gateways to something far more dangerous. A young girl's quiet life begins to fracture when she encounters a mysterious witch, one who doesn't just see through mirrors, but manipulates what lies within them. As strange occurrences ripple through her town, reality itself seems to blur, and the line between memory and illusion becomes dangerously thin. Each reflection reveals fragments of hidden truths: forgotten pasts, suppressed desires, and unsettling possibilities. But the deeper she is drawn into this mirrored world, the more she risks losing her sense of self entirely.

Togawa started Black Witch Mirror as a short mini-series in Vol. 101 of Kadokawa 's Harta magazine in February 2023. The full series then launched in Kadokawa 's Harta Alternative web magazine in October 2023. Kadokawa shipped the third compiled book volume on April 15. Titan Manga will ship the first volume in English on December 15.

title: Netflix’s Godzilla Anime Hit Really Needs a Season 2
content:
Godzilla has been on the rise in popularity over several decades, rampaging its way to new heights across countless media, including Hollywood and Japanese movies, TV shows, anime series , video games, comics, and more. However, one of its most underrated projects is the 2021 Netflix anime, Godzilla Singular Point , which was produced by Studio Bones and Orange. The anime stood out for its villain, as he was easily one of the terrifying ones across the kaiju’s history. What truly makes Singular Point so dangerous is that he doesn’t have one distinct look, but continues to evolve over the course of the story. As the villain took new forms, he evolved into something even more destructive on top of being functionally immortal.

The anime followed the story of Yun Arikawa and his partner, Haberu Katou, who were on a mission to investigate a house rumored to be haunted. However, they never expected to stumble into a mystery that threw the entire planet into chaos. The anime was released in 2021 and immediately drew fans’ attention for its exceptional story. Not to mention that it even won the anime won the 53rd Seiun Award in the Best Media category in 2022. However, even though more than five years have passed since the anime’s debut, there has been no confirmation of a sequel season.

Godzilla Singular Point Needs a Season 2 After the Post-Credits Scene

During the time of its production, it was evident that the production studios had plans for returning with the series, but things changed after the release. Although the main conflict of the first season was resolved with Jet Jaguar defeating Godzilla, things got interesting in the post-credits scene. The post-credits scene not only teases major future threats, but it also confirms that Goro Ashihara, the genius scientist believed to be dead or vanished, is actually in a secret facility constructing a Mechagodzilla.

The man-made monster is created using the original Godzilla skeleton and red dust/Archetype technology, confirming that humanity and the surviving forces will face a new and more powerful antagonist than ever. However, even after a cliffhanger, it appears the studios have ditched the series, considering it wasn’t a groundbreaking commercial hit. Japanese fans loved the series, as evidenced by the fact that it topped Netflix charts and overperformed in merchandising sales on top of winning awards.

However, the reception in the West wasn’t too positive, considering many found the constant kaiju fights confusing. Not to mention that the series leaned too much into the heavy scientific exposition without resolving many questions. While the series hasn’t been officially cancelled yet, there’s no guarantee that the anime will ever return with a sequel, especially after more than five years of silence from the animation studios. It was released as a collaborative project between Studio Bones and Studio Orange, both of which are heavily occupied with their multiple other anime projects.

Do you think Godzilla Singular Point deserves a second season? What would you like to see in the anime if it returns? Share your thoughts in the comments.

title: 3 Things You Need to Know for Re:Zero Season 5
content:
One of the biggest Isekai franchises now streaming with Crunchyroll has now confirmed it’s coming back for Season 5 in the near future. The anime adaptation for Tappei Nagatsuki and Shinichirou Otsuka has been on an incredible run for the past decade as it now celebrates its 10th anniversary. The series made its comeback with its fourth season earlier this Summer, and wrapped up its run without any word on a potential return . While the story has always been known for its dark themes and tragedies, things took a massive turn in the latest season when Subaru Natsuki was forced to witness his friends die in gruesome ways, forcing him to realize his weakness.

But thankfully the future has been set in place not long after. Re:Zero -Starting Life in Another World- fans thankfully didn’t have to wait too long to find out whether or not the anime would be continuing as it has now been officially announced that the anime is now in production on Season 5. During a special event in Japan this weekend to help celebrate the 10th anniversary of the TV anime’s original debut, Re:Zero -Starting Life in Another World- has now confirmed Season 5 is in the works with the first look at the coming episodes.

3) Re:Zero Season 5 Has Yet to Confirm Release Date

Since the Fall 2026 anime series have already been revealed, the sequel will only be released next year. The announcement was made earlier this month with a promotional video that shares a brief glimpse at everything that has happened in the anime so far. Instead of sharing spoilers on what to expect from the sequel, the teaser only confirms the sequel without a lot of details. While fans await updates on the anime, at the very least, it’s guaranteed that the sequel will land on Crunchyroll.

It’s the primary streaming home for the series, where you can catch up with all the seasons. The fourth season has been running for two cours, and it was scheduled for 19 episodes. While the English dub was released simultaneously with the subbed episodes for the first cour, the schedule changed when the anime returned from hiatus. Instead of typically dividing the fourth season into two parts, the anime went on a few weeks of hiatus after the Loss Arc ended in Episode 11.

2) Re:Zero Season 5 Puts Rem in the Spotlight

With Rem now fully back in the picture, but seemingly without any of her memories of her time with Subaru, the two of them need to find a connection once more in this new circumstance. They have been separated from everyone else with that cliffhanger. While Season 4 was working its way through the Recapture Arc with its new episodes airing this Summer, but the latest episode just had one of its biggest shocks yet with the “return” of Rem for the first time in ten years.

She had gone into a coma at the end of the first season following Gluttony’s attack, and she makes a special return to get Subaru ready to get back into the action. But with Gluttony now moving into action, there’s a hope that Rem’s full return won’t be too far along from this point. She was brought to the tower with the hope of figuring out how to bring her back from her coma, and her existence within this mysterious space proves that she’s still out there for Subaru and the others to find.

1) Re:Zero Creator Teases a More Grueling Journey Than Ever

With Subaru overcoming all of the challenges of the Loss and Recapture Arcs seen in the fourth season, Rem has finally woken up from her coma and is set to be an active part in the series once more.On congratulating the anime franchise for making it to its fifth season, original series creator Tappei Nagatsuki teased a bit of the brutal journey that Subaru is about to embark on in Season 5. As for what’s coming, it turns out Re:Zero -Starting Life in Another World- is about to get even more intense than what happened before , “The sixth arc covered in Season 4 has been called one of the most difficult parts of Re:ZERO , but don’t worry!

The journey through the seventh arc is every bit as brutal, with the difficulty cranked all the way up to inferno.” “The story continues with the same reassuringly heart-breaking design you’ve come to expect—yes, ‘heart-breaking’ is intentional!” Nagatsuki continues to tease about the coming season. “Of course, it won’t all be hardship. There will also be plenty of new encounters, exciting developments, and scenes I can’t wait to see—and show you—in anime form!” With all sorts of wild events already going down, it’s hard to imagine how it’s going to get even wilder for Subaru in the coming season.

title: Witch Watch Season 2 Premieres 2027
content:
Witch Watch Season 2 is set to premiere in 2027. A teaser visual featuring the main character Nico Wakatsuki was also released. The second season was previously announced immediately after the first season’s finale, which premiered on October 5, 2025.

Bibury Animation Studios animated the first season with a total of 25 episodes . Hiroshi Ikehata was the director, while Masao Kawase was the assistant director. Deko Akao wrote the series composition, Haruko Iizuka designed the characters Yukari Hashimoto composed the music. The voice cast consists of the following:

• Rina Kawaguchi as Nico Wakatsuki

• Ryota Suzuki as Morihito Otogi

• Tomori Kusunoki as Nemu Miyao

• Kaito Ishikawa as Keigo Magami

• Kohei Amasaki as Kanshi Kazamatsuri

• Yuki Wakai as Miharu Kiryu

• Mikako Komatsu as Yuri Makuawa

• Rie Takahashi as Kara Minami

• Konomi Kohara as Kukumi Ureshino

• Yoshitsugu Matsuoka as Tenryu Kiyonomiya

Crunchyroll is streaming the first season of the anime, describing it as: Morihito Otogi is a high schooler with the strength of an ogre. Life is peaceful until his childhood friend and witch-in-training, Nico Wakatsuki, moves in. Nico is excited about their reunion and makes Morihito her familiar. Now, he must focus on his mission to protect Nico from prophesied dangers. Their mystical, problem-filled days are about to begin!

The anime is based on a manga written and illustrated by Kenta Shinohara. It has been serialized in Shueisha’s shonen manga magazine Weekly Shonen Jump since February 2021. There are currently 23 volumes in circulation. Viz Media is publishing it in English. title: SPITZ Band's Drummer Tatsuo Sakiyama Seriously Injured in Traffic Accident
content:
The official website for Japanese rock band SPITZ announced on Sunday that its drummer Tatsuo Sakiyama was rushed to the hospital after sustaining serious injuries across his entire body in a traffic accident. His injuries are not life-threatening, but he will be hospitalized for a period of time to focus on his treatment and recovery.

The band will use pre-existing recordings of Sakiyama's performances for upcoming television appearances and will perform promotional activity for their upcoming album kettle with the other three members. Sakiyama's hospitalization will not affect the release schedule for previously recorded material.

The band's management at Grasshopper will monitor Sakiyama's condition and announce decisions regarding the band's future appearances at events such as the "Be Fes" event in February and the " SPITZ Jamboree Tour 2027 'kettle'" event in March.

SPITZ has performed music for several anime projects such as the opening theme song for Spy×Family season 3 and the theme song for Detective Conan: Kurogane no Submarine (Iron Submarine) film , as well as the theme song for the live action film of Fumi Yoshinaga 's What Did You Eat Yesterday? ( Kinō Nani Tabeta? ) manga.
author: ANN

title: 3 Most Memorable Dragon Ball Villain Moments After 42 Years
content:
Usually the aura-farming is reserved for the good guys in Dragon Ball , but the franchise has produced some unforgettable villains too. The constant and overwhelming powering up to outmatch the Z Fighters gave the audience that sudden feeling of dread. Every time it felt like there was no way they’d overcome some of the sadistic monsters they came into contact with.

They ultimately find the way to victory, but it’s not without losses and sometimes death amongst earth’s defenders. The villains stop at nothing and regularly commit heinous acts to get their points across. That’s what makes Goku and his group such a perfect foil to the enemies . The group’s pure-heartedness and care for everyone else around them is where their strength lies, and these villains below took their swings at breaking them down.

3) Broly Selects His First Victim

Tough to top the introduction that original Broly gets in Dragon Ball Z: Broly – The Legendary Super Saiyan . The build up of him constantly yelling out, “Kakarot!,” swatting Vegeta’s attacks away like a fly and ultimately transforming into the Legendary Super Saiyan, are all mind-blowing moments. Pantera’s 10’s breakdown kicks in perfectly, to pair up with him physically exploding into a larger Saiyan in the English dub, while screaming out before cackling like a maniac.

It’s an awesome scene that makes the hair on the back of your neck stand up. Then to top it all off, Broly points at Goku and says in his gravelly voice, “You Kakarot, I choose you to the best first of my victims.” An unhinged line that he backs up quickly by dominating all the Z Fighters in the initial battle. Goku pays back the big Saiyan with a ultra-powered punch that finishes the job. Who cares that this movie is non-canon? It provided audiences with one of the best villains in the series.

2) Cell Survives Detonation Of Goku

From relief to sheer horror in a short time, the Z Fighters got a terrible surprise when Super Perfect Cell returned to earth. Cell threatened to blow up everyone on the planet after his loss to Gohan. Goku simply Instant Transmissions himself and Cell to King Kai’s Planet to “safely-ish” detonate Cell away from earth. It looked like the move saved everyone and defeated Cell for good. Only for him to return and state that he’s even stronger through all of power he absorbed from Goku and Piccolo to become the perfect organism.

His condescending tone and cocky smirk just made him an impossible-to-beat enemy. Cell made it sound like all their efforts were futile, and he brought that fear to fruition by surviving his own detonation. Cell becomes so strong that the only way to defeat him is for Gohan to hit a Kamehameha that legitimately envelops and overwhelms his enemy. The blast initially does enough damage to defeat Cell, but just to make sure, Gohan increases the power to eviscerate every last microscopic cell of Cell.

1) Frieza Changes The Franchise’s Tone Forever

Dragon Ball Z had already started down a darker, grittier path than its predecessor, but it really turned up a few notches in the Frieza Saga. Goku sacrifices himself to help Piccolo kill Raditz , which started off the heavy plot points, but what Frieza does is burned into so many audience member’s minds. The evil lord decided to punish Goku for making him battle with a low-class Saiyan. He picks up a defenseless Krillin, levitating him with a wave of his finger. He then clenches his fist together and blows up.

The effortlessness it took to for Frieza to do it, and in such a merciless manner, was blood curdling. Everything changed in a hurry, and even though he thought it would shake Goku’s resolve, the Saiyan went the opposite way. The sadistic move only angered Goku more and resulted in the first ever Super Saiyan transformation. Not long after that, he defeated Frieza, bringing an end to wicked ruler. Since Frieza embodies pure evil and continues to be a recurring thorn in the Z Fighters’ side, this scene had to rank No. 1 in the series. Did we get the list right? Let us know in the comments.

title: Major Shonen Jump Anime Confirms Season 2 Return After Manga Finale (First Look Revealed)
content:
A major Shonen Jump series has officially released its final chapter after five years, and now it’s confirmed the anime’s return for its second season after the manga’s grand finale. Kenta Shinohara’s Witch Watch first announced it was going to be ending with its final chapter last week , and now that’s indeed come to pass as the manga has ended its run after 270 chapters of serialization. But thankfully it’s now been revealed that this is far from the end of the franchise moving forward.

Witch Watch wrapped up the TV anime’s debut season last year after a successful first outing. It was such a hit that the franchise quickly confirmed that Season 2 would be in the works, but not much had been revealed about the new season at the time. But with the end of the manga this week, Witch Watch Season 2 has released its first look as it gears up for its debut next year. You can check it out below.

Witch Watch Season 2 Confirms 2027 Release

Now that Witch Watch has officially ended with Shueisha’s Weekly Shonen Jump magazine after a five year run , Witch Watch has confirmed that Season 2 of the anime will be making its debut on screens sometime next year. No release date or window has been announced as of this time, nor have any details about potential returning production staff or cast neither. It’s still a rather mysterious production, but with a 2027 return set it won’t be too much longer before the anime starts to reveal more about what to expect from its return.

Witch Watch’ s debut season was directed by Hiroshi Ikehata and Masao Kawase for Bibury Animation Studios with Deko Akao handling the scripts, Haruko Iizuka handling the character designs, Mutsumi Takemiya editing the anime, and Yukari Hashimoto composing the music. There’s a hope that the production staff will be returning for their respective roles given how well received that first season was last year , but the voice cast is ready for their new season coming our way.

Witch Watch Cast Says Their Goodbyes to Witch Watch

“Congratulations on the completion of the original work!” Nico voice star Rina Kawaguchi stated in a special message to Witch Watch creator Kenta Shinohara on the anime’s official website . “Thank you for the wonderful story! I truly love both the comedic episodes, which are full of Shinohara-sensei’s signature style and make viewers happy, and the serious episodes that really tighten things up.” But although the star is saying goodbye to the series, there’s a hope she returns in the anime’s future.

If you wanted to catch up on Witch Watch ahead of the second season, you can now find its episodes now streaming with platforms such as Netflix, Hulu and Hulu on Disney+, Crunchyroll and more in the meantime with both Japanese and English language audio. You can also check out the manga’s final chapter completely for free with Shueisha’s MangaPlus service or Viz Media’s digital Shonen Jump library. And given its wacky adventures and intense action, you’re going to want to.

Are you excited to see Witch Watch return for a new season? What are you hoping to see from the new episodes? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments.

title: Naruto Shadow Rising Drops New Tease for Original Creator’s Manga Return
content:
Naruto ‘s original creator Masashi Kishimoto is returning to the franchise for a new manga to help expand its timeline, and Shueisha’s Weekly Shonen Jump has dropped a new tease for the creator’s big return. Naruto is now in the midst of a massive new endeavor with the intent of releasing new manga, TV anime, video game projects and more over the next few years. But the biggest new release coming down the pipeline is a return to the story from Kishimoto himself with a new piece of Naruto’s life.

Naruto Shadow Rising was shockingly announced to be in the works earlier this Fall during a worldwide streaming panel at New York Comic Con 2026. Revealed to be a new manga from Masashi Kishimoto himself, not much in the way of concrete information has been confirmed as of this time. But one of the latest issues of Shonen Jump ( as spotted by @Shinuki1992 on X ) has given fans a new tease about Naruto ‘s new manga return.

What Is Naruto Shadow Rising ?

Naruto Shadow Rising features Kishimoto returning with a new manga story, but it’s yet to be revealed what kind of shape this new story will take. It could be a single one-shot story focusing on a time Naruto and Sasuke fought before Naruto became the Hokage ( something that was not shown during the events of the main series ), or it could be a miniseries with multiple chapters set to release much like other sequels of its kind like Jujutsu Kaisen Modulo . But there are still many other questions surrounding this return that just keep popping up.

Naruto Shadow Rising seems to take place after the original series, but before the events of the Boruto: Naruto Next Generations sequel . It’s kind of like Dragon Ball Super’ s situation where it can’t do too much without interfering with the canon of its future events seen in the sequel, but that franchise has gone on for so long that it’s basically become its own timeline. That could be the case with this manga return, or it could end after a single chapter. We’ll find out soon enough when it takes the stage during Jump Festa 2027 later this year.

What Does This Mean for Naruto ‘s Future?

Naruto is one of the many franchises that Shueisha will be showcasing during Jump Festa 2027 over the December 19-20 weekend , and it’s been confirmed that fans will get their next major update about Naruto Shadow Rising at the time as well. This will likely help to alleviate some of the questions fans have about it all such as potential release format and schedule, length of its story and more. Either way, it’s a big deal as Kishimoto readies for a full comeback to manga after all this time.

Naruto also has many other new projects now in the works for the near future such as a new crossover anime revival together with a Shonen Jump classic, Naruto x Ninku , a new trading card game hitting shelves, a new mobile game title readying for its launch, and even a new live-action feature film heading into production next year. But what are you most excited to see coming from Naruto next? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments.

HT – @Shinuki1992 on X
